confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from national and NSW price ranges in the search results. Coffee and beer use national survey and tracker averages. Cocktail and wine use Sydney and Melbourne menu ranges and crowd-sourced data, adjusted down for a regional coastal city. Meal anchors use blog, fintech and crowd-sourced ranges. No current Wollongong-specific price survey was found. The only Wollongong-specific source (TravelTables) dates from 2023, and MyLifeElsewhere figures are crowd-sourced. Cocktail and wine were weakly sourced, so they were set relative to the beer anchor: cocktail about twice beer, wine glass slightly above beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Wollongong context. No accommodation search or live listing check was performed. FX provenance: the USD per AUD value is the most recent observation found, dated 2026-11-03, reported by a secondary market source as the RBA 4pm reference. The RBA F11.1 table itself was not read, and a later daily observation may exist that was not verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink reflect Australian national averages adjusted for Wollongong as a regional NSW city, generally priced below Sydney and Melbourne menus. MyLifeElsewhere's crowd-sourced estimate that Wollongong restaurant meals run slightly above the national average was used as a rough check. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a regional NSW coastal city about 80 km south of Sydney, not derived from a named comparable city.
